_comment: Each row of docs/assurance/falsification-plan.md ends in a **Detection:** line naming a
test module. Nine of the ten named modules did not exist when this baseline was written.
This file records that debt by name so the existence check can run green today without
hiding the debt. It is a ratchet, not a threshold: a detector that lands must be removed
from not_yet_built in the same change, and the guard fails if a row listed here now exists.
The list therefore shrinks to empty and cannot be edited to silence a red run.
Do not add a row to this file. A new Detection line naming a file that does not exist is
the defect the guard was built to catch.
